open_questions: Phase-curve step at phase 0.3136 (secondary snr 6.829) should be checked with ground-based photometry to confirm it is not an EB occultation at non-half phase.
Precise eccentricity / impact parameter follow-up (duration ratio 1.528) to reconcile observed 3.999 h duration with 2.618 h central duration.
RV mass measurement to rule out brown dwarf at small-star radius, though rp 1.5 Rearth favours planet.
dossier.public_summary: TESS shows a steady 394 ppm flat-bottom dip every 6.6 days that centroid imaging places on the target star with no nearby blend able to mimic it. The size is about 1.5 Earth radii and shows no significant odd-even or secondary eclipse beyond a faint pipeline step, favouring a small planet around a K dwarf. The period and depth match the pattern of five previously confirmed planets with similar checks.

reasons.why: Difference imaging puts dip on target and rules out neighbours, strong evidence against a blended binary despite 11 could_cause stars.
reasons.value: on_target offset 2.212 err 4.801 sigma 0.4607, suspects 10.8-15.9 sigma away

reasons.why: Planet-sized; far below stellar regime, no spectroscopic binary flagged (ruwe 1.065, non_single_star 0).
Long for central duration but consistent across TIC/FLAME/GSP-Phot, explained as off-centre (fit_b 0.3308) not giant-star or secondary.
Flat-bottom transit, opposite of V-shaped binary/grazing preference.
Depth steady after accounting for product differences, not a variable depth.
Below 4-sigma threshold for significant odd/even difference.

Secondary at 0.3136 phase is offset from 0.5 and near best_brightening_snr 4.679; step not centered at phase 0.5 and not recurring in odd_even suggests p-fold artefact from pipeline/phase-curve rather than EB occultation.
Modest swing expected for spotted VARIABLE star and does not co-occur with non-transit shape, so not favouring close binary.

Moderate planet score but low false-positive proxies (centroid on_target, no V-shape, star_density_penalty 138.3 per fit) and five nearest analogues confirmed as planets support planet as best explanation.
